description: Calculate monthly gross revenue, refunds, and net revenue for the online store. Gross revenue is the sum of amount for all orders with status in ('completed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded'). Refunds are attributed to the month of the ORIGINAL order (order_ts), not the month the refund was issued. An order can have multiple partial refunds. Net revenue = gross revenue - refunds. Output columns: month (DATE), gross_revenue (FLOAT64), refund_amount (FLOAT64), net_revenue (FLOAT64).

order_id.description: Foreign key to orders; zero or more refunds per order

refund_ts.description: UTC timestamp when the refund was issued

edge_cases: Order with two partial refunds must not have its gross amount counted twice
Refund issued in a later month is still attributed to the order month
Orders with no refunds must yield refund_amount = 0, not NULL
Fully refunded orders remain in gross revenue
common_failure_modes: FM1: LEFT JOIN orders to refunds and then SUM(amount) duplicates gross revenue for orders with multiple refunds
FM2: Grouping refunds by refund_ts month instead of order_ts month
FM5: gross - SUM(refund_amount) returns NULL for months without refunds when COALESCE is missing
